gaps.sentence: The test measures your ___ (STRONG) in each skill.
gaps.explanation: 'Strength' is the noun; 'strengthen' is the verb 'to make stronger'.

gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.
